verdict.rationale: Asana's official MCP server documentation lists generating reports and summaries from Asana data as a supported use case. That lets an AI assistant draft a summary of project work, but the evidence never describes a native feature that drafts project or initiative status updates from recent activity. The status-update tutorial is only a developer building block, and the AI Teammates and Dash marketing claims are too vague to count. Missing for 10: a documented native AI status-update drafting feature, coverage of initiative or portfolio-level updates, explicit use of recent activity as input, a way to publish the draft as an Asana status update, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity

citations.quote: Generate reports and summaries based on Asana data
From a single ChatGPT conversation, you can check on portfolios, create and assign tasks, kick off new projects, and review work
